scope: App-unwired additive per-execution index dispatcher selection and real Redis reply retention; no native Celery producer/worker acceptance
checks: Existing build uses configured default dispatcher.
Two concurrent build_with_dispatcher executions retain distinct immutable trace labels, source IDs and retry values; each requests five-second child deferral.
Aborted caller retains caller guard and physical job while its dispatcher awaits real Redis BLPOP reply.
Shutdown reports incomplete during that actual reply; caller and physical job release after reply.
Native file-path gate replays eighteen literal SQL/file outcomes and two controlled relative reopen schedules.
limitations: The dispatcher test uses controlled immutable trace labels and actual Redis reply ownership; it does not emit a Celery child envelope or verify result children.
Source109 is the independent authoritative original index wire/ACK/lineage corpus; native worker/producer interoperability remains separate.
SourcePathContext remains opt-in and app-unwired, with volume/cutover/UID migration still open.
